name: EXAMPLE — The Lantern Review Open Call
eligibility: Emerging writers worldwide; unpublished work only.
note: A thoughtful home for work that finds meaning in the everyday.

name: EXAMPLE — Field Notes Emerging Photographer Grant
eligibility: Photographers in the first five years of their practice.
note: Supports a new documentary series rooted in a local community.

name: EXAMPLE — Alder House Winter Residency
award: Two weeks of studio space and a private room
eligibility: Writers based in North America; travel not included.
note: A quiet, self-directed stay in a small coastal community.

name: EXAMPLE — Open Frame Photo Fellowship
award: $3,000 stipend and a mentor for six months
eligibility: Early-career image-makers working on a long-term project.
note: Invites patient projects made with care and curiosity.

name: EXAMPLE — Small Hours Essay Prize
eligibility: Writers over 18; essays must be 3,000 words or fewer.
note: For clear-eyed personal essays on belonging and change.

name: EXAMPLE — Common Ground Editorial Fellowship
eligibility: Open to writers without a traditional publishing contract.
note: Applications are read in the order they arrive throughout the year.
